text:
Marta: Quick design review — pushed an updated routing editor layout to Figma. Need eyes on ordering affordances, validation copy, and preview behaviour. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (use the 'routing/editor-v2' page).
Leo: Looking now. Immediate thought: drag handle is huge, makes the list feel heavy. Can we go with a slim left 'grip' (8px) instead of the full pill? :eyes: 
Oliver: Agree on handle. Also re: keyboard reorder — currently only up/down arrows work but we don't announce moves to screen readers. @Aria any suggestions for aria-live messages?
Aria: We should announce reorder and validation errors via aria-live. Suggested short phrases: 'Rule moved to position 2' and for errors: 'Priority conflict: two rules share priority 10'. Keep them terse.
Rachael: Copy nit: current banner reads 'Priority must be unique' which is terse and a bit cryptic. Proposed copy: 'Each rule must have a unique priority number. Click Auto-assign or edit the priority to fix.'
Sam: Preview simulation perf note — sim takes ~4-5s on staging for medium-sized flows. UX-wise we should avoid a generic spinner. Suggest skeleton + small progress bar and a one-line status: 'Simulating with model: redwood-4b-quant' so users know what's running.
Marta: Good call. Also we should show which variant used in the preview header and a timestamp for when the snapshot was taken.
Oliver: UX edge case: when a canary rollout is active the preview shows simulated decisions but the 'applied order' on deployment may differ. Suggest a two-line header: 'Visual order (preview)' and 'Deployed order' with a toggle to compare.
Leo: Accessibility: drag-only reordering is bad for keyboard users. Add inline 'Move up' / 'Move down' buttons (icon-only allowed) with proper aria-labels. Also expose a single 'Reorder mode' so focus doesn't get lost.
Aria: Keyboard shortcuts would be great — propose Alt+K to move selected rule up and Alt+J down, but we need to audit conflicts with browser/OS shortcuts. Also announce 'move completed' in aria-live.
Rachael: Quick copy suggestion for invalid priority block (proposal below):

```
Priority error
Each rule must have a unique integer priority. Suggested fixes:
• Click 'Auto-assign' to re-number your rules.
• Edit priority values directly in the list.
```

Oliver: Implementation note from API side — the service currently returns error code `invalid_order` with payload duplicates [10,10]. We should map that to inline per-rule errors (flag the two rules) rather than a generic top banner. That makes remediation faster.
Marta: Action items: Leo to update Figma with 8px handle + move buttons, Aria to draft aria-live strings and shortcut doc, Oliver to change API mapping to per-rule errors, Sam to prototype progress bar and variant label in preview. I'll follow up in the PR thread and schedule a quick 15min sync if needed. :thumbsup:
